review_notes: Complete fixed public catalog:3row-transform functions(history,quote,search)+symbol_reference view. No ordinary tables/COPY or auth requirements. Registry lists8illustrativeformat examples, not fullinstrument universe. Both release/current substitute close when upstream adjclose is absent, with no per-cell origin flag; notebooks state this limitation. Current public source adds strict YYYY-MM-DD/inverted/lone-end date validation, fills newest missing close from regularMarketPrice only when its timestamp lies inside that newest candle, and clamps search count0/negative to1 instead of release fallback8. Examples/comments are expanded; devWrangler4.160→4.161 changes rootlock while runtime dependency specs stay unchanged. Function registration, schemas, symbol_reference VALUES, quote client/mapping and read transport match. These notebooks use valid closed2024windows, historical bars unaffected by newest-candle fill, and searchcount8: the reviewed differences do not change those selected operations. Current compatible interface coverage does not claim exact current runtime execution or universal behavioral equivalence.
